name: aeval-control
description: Agent-neutral control plane for aeval: the host-side model broker (aeval-model-broker/3) and the gateway-lease surface every agent control stack shares. Moved byte-identical from dsh-eval-control@4bc6931; agent packages compose their deployment dists from here. Built on the pinned @deepseek-ai/dsh-llm library (decision: keep as pinned library dependency, do not vendor).

scripts.test: npm run build && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test ".test-dist/test/*.test.js"
